title: Olive abandons her dreams

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Huh? Yeah. Sure. Fine. I mean I really feel like... nah. It's fine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Huh? Yeah. Sure. Fine. I mean I really feel like... nah. It's fine.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: It's just... did you ever give a fuck? Honestly? Because I thought you did, but now, when I think back, it seems like you didn't. You really didn't.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's just... did you ever give a fuck? Honestly? Because I thought you did, but now, when I think back, it seems like you didn't. You really didn't.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: My revolution... It was a slow one, you know? But every change - every material improvement in peoples lives - starts with one person giving a damn. It starts slow, but then it builds. An avalanche starts with a single snowflake, and I thought that snowflake was... never mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My revolution... It was a slow one, you know? But every change - every material improvement in peoples lives - starts with one person giving a damn. It starts slow, but then it builds. An avalanche starts with a single snowflake, and I thought that snowflake was... never mind.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Because that's what we need to make things better. Another pragmatist? I think we have plenty of those. In fact, in Nivalis, we're full up. You know, it was the "pragmatists" that fucked me over in the end.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because that's what we need to make things better. Another pragmatist? I think we have plenty of those. In fact, in Nivalis, we're full up. You know, it was the "pragmatists" that fucked me over in the end.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: I just keep going over everything you've said - all the times I needed some support, and... it's like you didn't believe in me at all. I just assumed you were standing behind me, but when I turned around, I realized the whole time, I was alone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I just keep going over everything you've said - all the times I needed some support, and... it's like you didn't believe in me at all. I just assumed you were standing behind me, but when I turned around, I realized the whole time, I was alone.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: You wasted my fucking time. That opportunity could have gone to someone else. I created a space for someone to go on a trip with me. You took that seat, but you never came with me on the journey.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You wasted my fucking time. That opportunity could have gone to someone else. I created a space for someone to go on a trip with me. You took that seat, but you never came with me on the journey.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Your mistake I guess. Only person dumber than you is me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your mistake I guess. Only person dumber than you is me.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: I liked me better then too. And I thought I liked you too. Being on the stone cold is...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I liked me better then too. And I thought I liked you too. Being on the stone cold is...

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: I dunno, but the revolution is postponed. My rivals made moves. Delbert and his O.R.S contingent pushed The Disciplinary Committee to find me guilty of "behavior unbecoming of.... blah blah blah." Fuck em.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I dunno, but the revolution is postponed. My rivals made moves. Delbert and his O.R.S contingent pushed The Disciplinary Committee to find me guilty of "behavior unbecoming of.... blah blah blah." Fuck em.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: I really believed in it all you know. It wasn't just the booze and drugs talking. I really believed someone could make a difference. I still do. But it's not me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I really believed in it all you know. It wasn't just the booze and drugs talking. I really believed someone could make a difference. I still do. But it's not me.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: There's a spiritual rot inside me. I feel like it needs scooped out, like the flesh of a rotten fruit. But then there will be nothing left of me. Just skin.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: There's a spiritual rot inside me. I feel like it needs scooped out, like the flesh of a rotten fruit. But then there will be nothing left of me. Just skin.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What were you going to say?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What were you going to say?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What were you going to say?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What were you going to say?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I never said I would support you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I never said I would support you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I never said I would support you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I never said I would support you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I like you better when you were drunk or high.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like you better when you were drunk or high.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I like you better when you were drunk or high.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I like you better when you were drunk or high.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Being this sober is too exposing. It's like going out in the cold wind without clothes or... skin. I feel everything too much. It's like the wind is blowing through my bones.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Being this sober is too exposing. It's like going out in the cold wind without clothes or... skin. I feel everything too much. It's like the wind is blowing through my bones.

nodes.speaker: Olive Nek
nodes.text: Very. Now excuse me. I'm off to find a handful of mushrooms and a quart of vodka. I won't be back for some time. Take care friendo.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Very. Now excuse me. I'm off to find a handful of mushrooms and a quart of vodka. I won't be back for some time. Take care friendo.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Being united would be so important!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Being united would be so important!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Being united would be so important!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Being united would be so important!
